requirements.evidence: CreateQueue trims name, slugifies `$slug ?? $name`, validates 1-255 and `Rule::unique('queues')->where('entity_id', ...)`, converts racing QueryException to ValidationException (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:31-55); UpdateQueue uses named nullable params with `->ignore($queue->id)` (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:28-79); no delete action; SetQueueAccess upserts/revokes, validates `Rule::enum(QueuePermission::class)` + `list`, rejects cross-entity membership, logs granted/revoked on `audit` only when a row was deleted (app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:38-87); migration has FKs with cascade, JSON permissions and unique pair; QueuePolicy create/update/manageAccess/call with `is_array($access?->permissions)` guard (app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:51-68); CallNextTicket authorizes after the inactive check (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:42); Ticket::call locks queue, checks inactive, authorizes, then waiting LogicException (app/Models/Ticket.php:93-113); factory keeps membership in the queue's entity; docs and CHANGELOG updated.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes in app/Actions with authorization inside via `Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize(...)`; auto-discovered App\Policies\QueuePolicy; `#[Fillable([...])]` on QueueAccess matches sibling models; migration has reversible `down()` with generated-style timestamp name; PHPDoc @throws on public methods; business-rules.md, database-schema.md, architecture.md and CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` Added updated; audit trail on `Log::channel('audit')` per logging conventions.

security.evidence: Every action authorizes first (CreateQueue.php:30, UpdateQueue.php:35, SetQueueAccess.php:38); both call paths enforce `call` under row locks; policy denies corrupted non-array permissions and grants on other queues; cross-entity membership rejected (SetQueueAccess.php:45-49); permissions whitelisted via enum rule; mass assignment restricted by Fillable. No weakness found.

tests.evidence: New tests cover create/update happy paths, slug scoping, DB-race conversion via `Queue::creating`/`Queue::updating` hooks, name bounds 255/256, blank names, unauthorized actors (employee, other-entity admin, outsider) with no-write assertions, policy matrix incl. corrupted JSON, cross-queue grant, every CallMode for denied and granted employees, Ticket::call ordering (inactive > authz > LogicException), audit spy for granted/revoked/no-op revoke, schema/cascade/factory tests (tests/Feature/Queue/*). Existing CallNextTicketTest callers updated to admins rather than weakened.

simplicity.evidence: Lean actions; duplicated unique-violation detection extracted into app/Support/UniqueViolation.php and reused by IssueTicket. Small duplication of the try/catch-to-ValidationException block between CreateQueue.php:41-55 and UpdateQueue.php:65-76, acceptable.

readability.evidence: Clear names and docblocks, comments explaining lock order (Ticket.php:94) and atomic upsert (SetQueueAccess.php:69). Minor: `use LogicException;` in the non-namespaced tests/Feature/Queue/CallAuthorizationTest.php:15 is a no-op import that triggers a PHP warning.

scope.evidence: Everything serves the task; the IssueTicket refactor (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:57) also silently drops the SQLSTATE `23000` branch from unique detection, a small behavioral change to an unrelated action. docs/architecture.md addition is in line with docs-sync.

issues.explanation: The extracted helper no longer treats SQLSTATE 23000 as a unique violation, changing IssueTicket's retry behavior beyond a pure refactor without a test or mention.
Relies on `User::membershipFor()`, which is not in the diff; correctness of the policy depends on that existing method behaving as assumed (lowered confidence).
`use LogicException;` in a global-namespace file has no effect and emits a PHP compile warning.
A valid 255-char name with characters that transliterate to multiple letters can produce a slug over 255 and be rejected with a slug error instead of the name being accepted.
The QueryException-to-ValidationException block is copied from CreateQueue; also on that path the in-memory $queue keeps the unsaved dirty attributes.

review.summary: The change adds CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess actions, the queue_access table/model/factory, the QueuePermission enum and a QueuePolicy, and enforces the `call` ability in both CallNextTicket and Ticket::call in the required order, with docs and changelog updated. It meets every requirement and contract detail with thorough tests for authorization, validation, races and audit logging; only small nits remain (a slight behavioral change in the shared unique-violation helper and a no-op import), so it is approvable with nits.
